rows.en: Yamato: "Honestly, you're as hard to wake up as ever..."
Melvi: "The sunshine's full of energy today too!"
you keep staying under the covers!
Come ooon, get up! Get up!"
O-ow!! What the hell are you doing?!"
Yamato: "It's because you won't wake up!
Melvi went to all the trouble of coming to get you!"
Yamato: "Don't go back to sleep, nyow!!"
I-I said don't bite! Okay, okay! I get it!"
Yamato: "Urp. I-I couldn't eat another bite..."
Touya: "...You eat too much. You'll get fat."
I'm sure you'd still be cute even if you got fat."
Yamato: "Somehow, that doesn't feel like you're helping..."
Paldia: "Oh, is it that time already?
They said Forzen was coming back!"
Ymir: "...Good morning. Am I a little too early...?"
Paldia: "Come in and wait a moment.
Touya: "...Are you okay? You look pale."
Touya: "Don't tell me you haven't slept."
Ymir: "N-no, I haven't... We have to establish
a countermeasure to Ze=Ode's special field
as soon as we possibly can..."
Touya: "It won't do any good if you make yourself sick doing it.
Take a little better care of yourself, okay?"
Thank you for worrying about me, Touya..."
Oh my, should I have waited a little longer?"
Clovis: "Hey, Touya. What are you doing out so early?"
Touya: "Huh? Aren't you going to welcome Forzen back?"
Clovis: "I never quite know how to deal with that old guy.
Besides, I've got a little business to take care of...
Well, with a 'flower' on each arm, you don't need that right now."
Touya: "What are you going on about this early in the morning...?"
Clovis: "...I see. So that's how it is."
Clovis: "Well, well. All night long? You two certainly are enthusiastic.
Even I'd find that tough. But, Touya,
you may have energy to spare,
but think about your partner too.
It won't last if only one of you is satisfied."
Paldia: "Oh my, are the two of you that close already?"
Clovis: "!! W-well, I've got a little business to take care of...
Melvi: "Oh... Uncle Clovis is with a lady..."
Touya: "...Sheesh. So that's what his little business was."
Could it be Forzen coming back...?"
Touya: "Oh, Lodis! What the heck happened?"
There was a sudden explosion at the tower..."
Ymir: "...But it seems to be working properly.
It doesn't look like it failed."
Lodis: "Yes. For the moment, at least..."
Forzen: "Well, that was quite an ordeal..."
Forzen: "Have you been a good girl,
Forzen: "...I'm home. You've become even more beautiful."
Paldia: "Flattery won't get you anything, you know."
...Oh, and who should I find here but Mr. Kazami?
I'm glad to see you're doing well."
Forzen: "My, with so many people here to welcome me,
I feel like something of a celebrity. Ha ha ha ha!"
Touya: "You're as much of an oddball as ever..."
We've had a bit of a problem."
Touya: "I figured. I'm wondering why you're alone."
Forzen: "Yes. I was actually supposed to bring
H-hey, don't tell me... You don't mean Kasumi?!"
I don't think she's very far away,
but honestly, it was quite a surprise. Ha ha ha ha!"
Touya: "Hey! How can you say that so cheerfully?!"
Forzen: "...I'm afraid that's simply how I am..."
Touya: "Damn it! What are you going to do
Touya: "Yeah. We've been together since we were kids...
She's what you'd call a childhood friend."
Touya: "Never mind that! Let's go rescue her!
You DO know where she is, right?!"
I'm having her coordinates calculated now."
Kasumi: "No way... Am I all alone...?
Touya: "No, I've just got a bad feeling..."
The place has become a Baluamy nest.
Touya: "Oh, when we were meeting up with the Liebhofen..."
Lodis: "They are a product of the Gazette Project,
which Marshal Revios pursued in secret. The biological weapons
escaped from the laboratory and seem to have reproduced."
Lodis: "Yes. What a troublesome thing he created..."
Touya: "Then she's in even worse danger!
What are we dragging our feet for?!"
Fain: "But wouldn't it be a problem to act without permission now?
Xiujian: "We have no time to waste
arguing here. If she is somewhere dangerous, every moment counts.
We can worry about the rest later."
Lodis: "You do not belong to any organization.
No one has the right to restrain you or give you orders.
Do not worry about the consequences. Please go."
Sisk: "Eee! Your Highness, you're so cool!♥"
Ymir: "Yes, that is a possibility too.
We should avoid drawing too much attention to ourselves."
Miyasco: "...Hey, did the captain just say something?"
?????: "The Liebhofen... You have come at a good time."
Ymir: "We already have the Baluamy's signatures registered, right?
Then try scanning for humans only."
Derock: "Two? What does that mean, you know?"

review_batches.context: Morning at the Clasio home; Melvi and Yamato wake Touya, Ymir arrives after working all night, and Clovis makes a mistaken innuendo. Read the entire 215-row member, including Forzen's return and Kasumi's rescue setup.
review_batches.decisions: Preserve familiar Big Brother/Big Sis addresses without inventing biological ties. Keep interrupted sleepy speech, snoring, written reactions and source row continuations. Ymir's fatigue is explained by research; Clovis's sexual insinuation is his mistaken joke, not narrator fact. One source row per English row, no byte-budget cuts.

row_decisions.scenario.s_009.o0002c.l00: Touya hears only fragments while asleep. Preserve an incomplete familial address and predicate, without inventing the missing full wake-up line.
row_decisions.scenario.s_009.o00123.l00: Big Brother Touya follows the affectionate address chosen in s_008; Melvi and Touya are not asserted to be blood relatives.
row_decisions.scenario.s_009.o00166.l00: Melvi's cheerful sunshine remark stays in her childlike voice. Do not identify the world's light source as Earth's Sun.
row_decisions.scenario.s_009.o001fb.l00: Keep the explicit snoring letters as a written sound; do not treat ZZZZZ as a variable or replace the row with dialogue.
row_decisions.scenario.s_009.o00242.l01: Yamato's effort sound precedes Touya's pain; no specific action is invented until Touya explicitly says biting at 24.
row_decisions.scenario.s_009.o0032f.l00: Touya trails off while trying to go back to sleep; Yamato's next line supplies the context.
row_decisions.scenario.s_009.o004c2.l01: Melvi goes to greet the arriving Ymir. Could you get that preserves the implied request without inventing a doorbell or telephone.
row_decisions.scenario.s_009.o00570.l00: Melvi's familiar Big Sis addresses her aunt Ymir. This does not change the established family tree.
row_decisions.scenario.s_009.o00698.l00: Negative English answer to haven't slept must be explicit: no, I haven't. Preserve her research motivation and the earliest-possible timing, not a one-day deadline.
row_decisions.scenario.s_009.o0079c.l00: Paldia begins saying she is ready, then deliberately interrupts herself to tease the pair.
row_decisions.scenario.s_009.o007e7.l00: The source calls Paldia sister-in-law; use her given name as a natural familiar address, without changing their established relationship.
row_decisions.scenario.s_009.o008e5.l02: Keep quoted flower imagery because Paldia echoes it immediately. Clovis contrasts Touya's female company with his own private business.
row_decisions.scenario.s_009.o009f5.l00: Clovis mistakes Ymir's all-night research fatigue for an intimate night with Touya. Preserve the innuendo without adding any explicit act or implying that it occurred.

review_batches.context: Clovis's joke ends; an explosion accompanies Forzen's return, and the group discovers Kasumi was separated during transport and landed in Muur Forest. Read all 215 rows, with adjacent replies and earlier character relationships.
review_batches.decisions: Keep Forzen's polite, unruffled manner and Touya's anger, the 203-16 coordinates, childhood-friend disclosure, and uncertainty about transport/field status. Keep Kasumi's Touya-chan address, hidden speaker labels and unfinished reactions. Source continuations and interjections retain deliberate fragments.

row_decisions.scenario.s_009.o009f5.l04: Clovis means a relationship will not last with one-sided satisfaction. Keep the advice directed at Touya and his supposed partner.
row_decisions.scenario.s_009.o00b11.l00: Touya's address-only Yamato line is a deliberate implied threat following the biting earlier. Do not add an explicit attack command absent from the source.
row_decisions.scenario.s_009.o00b9d.l00: Uncle Clovis is Melvi's familiar older-man address, not proof of kinship.
row_decisions.scenario.s_009.o00d83.l01: The link between the explosion and Forzen's return is tentative; do not make Yamato certain of the cause.
row_decisions.scenario.s_009.o00e75.l00: The transport equipment still seems operational. Neither Ymir's nor Lodis's cautious assessment guarantees that everyone arrived safely.
row_decisions.scenario.s_009.o00f14.l01: Miss Melvi preserves Forzen's playful politeness to his own daughter.
row_decisions.scenario.s_009.o01059.l00: Touya remarks on Forzen's usual eccentric/unruffled manner, rather than accusing him of a newly established lie.
row_decisions.scenario.s_009.o010d3.l00: Forzen was supposed to bring a new person, but lost contact during transport. His lack of concern is contrasted with Touya's anger; don't soften the latter.
row_decisions.scenario.s_009.o0123b.l00: Together since childhood describes a childhood friendship; do not make them siblings, spouses or a confirmed couple.
row_decisions.scenario.s_009.o012fc.l01: Retain the exact coordinate digits and separator as 203-16; location reaction trails off.
row_decisions.scenario.s_009.o014d4.l00: Touya has a bad feeling; no confirmed telepathy is asserted.

review_batches.context: Lodis explains the Baluamy and political limits; Xiujian insists on rescuing Kasumi. The Liebhofen arrives to find two human signatures amid many creatures. Final 55 rows; all 215 examined.
review_batches.decisions: Preserve Gazette Project/Marshal Revios terminology, biological reproduction as a report, captain's minimal Mm with Ymir's much longer apparent interpretation, concealed rescuer identity, exact scan count and both FC:3C:3E controls. Retain the heart for later native glyph support. No inferred rescuer identity, faction affiliation or completed rescue.

row_decisions.scenario.s_009.o015ab.l02: Baluamy reproduction is reported as apparent, not a scientific explanation invented for the weapons.
row_decisions.scenario.s_009.o01674.l01: The source only says assembly here. Do not silently merge the separately named League Assembly and Agarthian Council.
row_decisions.scenario.s_009.o016af.l00: Touya's dismissive response is interrupted by Xiujian; no completed policy decision is added.
row_decisions.scenario.s_009.o01778.l00: Arthur's address to Lodis is intentionally a request conveyed by title alone; do not reverse it into an offer of help.
row_decisions.scenario.s_009.o017eb.l00: Keep the heart symbol and mark native font support pending rather than deleting a source cue.
row_decisions.scenario.s_009.o01892.l00: Ymir appears to understand Roa's minimal utterance. Preserve her reply without supplying what the captain supposedly said or specifying the unnamed possibility.
row_decisions.scenario.s_009.o01a78.l00: Five-question-mark rescuer stays concealed through the member. Young lady addresses Kasumi; no gender, name or rank for the rescuer is inferred.
row_decisions.scenario.s_009.o01bb1.l00: Them refers to the surrounding creatures, confirmed by the later scan. No number or defeated-enemy count is invented.
row_decisions.scenario.s_009.o01ca7.l01: Exactly two human signatures, with both wait controls in the same order. The creature signatures are separately discussed afterward.
